author: V. D. Winter
title: 7 individuals booked at Jefferson County facilities on June 7
text:
Records indicate 7 people were booked across three different facilities in Jefferson, Alabama, on June 7, 2026.
Five entries involved charges in the ‘Drug’ category. The ‘Other’ category appeared in three cases, while ‘Violent,’ ‘Warrant,’ and ‘Property’ each appeared once. The charge “POSSESSION OF CONTROLLED SUBSTANCE – HALLUCINOGEN – POSSESS” was the most frequent, listed in four separate entries.
Booking data represent charges as of the time of booking. Based solely on these records, none of the named individuals has been convicted.
